wedo_instance.description: Formalizing the MetaGit-SeedTree architectural bond and Node.js/V8 runtime philosophy.

meta.philosophy: MetaGit provides the Forensic Substrate; SeedTree provides the Metabolic Logic. Node.js (V8) acts as the browser-of-sorts runtime.

tasks.description: Document Eukaryotic Repos: Define Subject (e.g., memory/public/ - leaf fruit like json/py/md), Object (passthroughs), and Hybrid (e.g., memory/ - container + local comms).
Define Function Pair Duality: Ensure every .py has a context .json and a 'compressed logic prompt' for generative reconstruction.
Map Metabolic Loci: Institutionalize the SeedTree recursion (_0 Kernel, _1 Branch, _2 Leaf) and locational DNS strings (e.g., _0.method.$n.event.$m).
Establish Runtime Sovereignty: Frame the Meta-Root as a V8-powered browser-of-sorts, treating root modules as localhost websites capable of HTML generation.
Forensic Commitment: Execute metagit_commit across repositories to anchor these architectural realizations.
